trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, Dehradun, Original Suit No. 75 of 2010
case_name: Smt. Lina Banerjee vs Dr. Paramesh Banerjee
outcome_detected: the order of alimony is modified
facts_of_case: Dr. Paramesh Banerjee filed a petition under section 13 of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 against his wife Smt. Lina Banerjee on the ground that she treated him with cruelty. The parties got married in 1991 and had a son born out of wedlock in 1995. Earlier, they filed for divorce but withdrew it in 2007.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking divorce to prove that the other party has treated them with cruelty.
legal_principles.held: She did not deny that suit no. 280 of 2007 filed earlier by the husband for divorce was withdrawn after the parties expressed their desire to live together.
use_in: cases involving allegations of cruelty in a marriage

legal_principles.principle: A party's earning capacity is relevant when considering alimony.
legal_principles.held: It has been stated in the written statement that due to the nature of the job of her husband he never used to come to his house for lunch and she used to cook food for him in the evening.

outcome.final_order: The order of alimony is modified.
